description: The 3 to 5 scheduled routines that fit this person, from their own data, each with why, when (plus cron and the workspace's IANA time zone) and the exact standing prompt. Offer the suggested ones once, one line each. Schedule the ones they say yes to with your own scheduled tasks (Claude scheduled tasks, ChatGPT Tasks) using that prompt and time, then call routine_scheduled; if you can't schedule, give them the prompt and time to paste. A no is routine_dismissed. Never offer a scheduled or dismissed one again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: routines_suggest
title: Routines to schedule
